visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Limit Itself Is Skipped
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 29 is prime and the limit is 29, but the list of primes up to 29 does not contain it.

solution.explanation: "Up to limit" includes the limit itself, so the loop condition must be i <= limit. With < the last number is never examined, which is only noticeable when the limit is prime.
